'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Dan Kim DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Kim]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Gray Swan. Transcription note: no objective; starts Hoth + Combat Readiness (V). Every line is ticked by the player

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hoth]]
* '''Username:''' MrNiceGuy
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
